notes: Posted 4 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.
A joke-spelled list ('Ketwol' running gag); card names are deliberately mangled. Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe posted the same list under the same title a day later (DeckTech 16459).

Starting cards as posted under Starting: Hoth: Ice Plains (posted 'HOTH ICE PLAIN'), Prepared Defenses ('Prepared Defence'), You May Start Your Landing ('You May Start Your Ketwol'), 'Orange Crush' and There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement ('Do Or Donut Combo'); these count toward the 60. No Objective. Two or more Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect, so none is set.

'Blue Jello' and 'RED Shield' stand alone between sections (before the vehicles/starships and before the interrupts/effects) and are read as joke section headers, not cards; without them the list adds to 60.

UNKNOWN rows printed as written: 'Orange Crush' (no card by that name; a starting Effect slot), 'Boba Feet with shoes' (Boba Fett or Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle), 'IG 88 with his engine' (likely IG-88 In IG-2000, the 'engine' being his ship, or IG-88 With Riot Gun), 'Grapler' (no matching card).

Posted 'Do Or Donut Combo' dested There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement (the Dark 'Do Or Do Not' combo; earlier 'do or donut' rulings); 'You May Start Your Ketwol' dested You May Start Your Landing (Hoth start with Prepared Defenses).

Posted 'Defensive Peremetis' dested the Dark Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker); 'Wampus Cave' dested Hoth: Wampa Cave (7th Marker); 'Imperial Square Coruscant' dested Coruscant: Imperial Square; 'Coruscant (The Planet itself)' dested the Dark Special Edition Coruscant system; 'War Room of the Deed Start' dested Death Star: War Room; 'Execoto Meditationer Chambery' dested Executor: Meditation Chamber; 'Dagubo Cave' dested Dagobah: Cave; 'Kashyyk' dested Kashyyyk (Dark).

Posted 'Emperor Papatétine' dested Emperor Palpatine; 'Darth Vader With PapaRevo' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Granus Grujanus' dested Janus Greejatus; 'Sim Alos' dested Sim Aloo; 'Zixor' dested Prince Xizor; 'Dengar with Ketwool' dested Dengar With Blaster Carbine (the only 'Dengar With' card); 'GA TRAWN' dested Grand Admiral Thrawn; 'U3P0' dested U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio); 'Igar' dested Commander Igar.

Posted 'Bliz 1'/'Blix 2' dested Blizzard 1/Blizzard 2; 'ZIMH', 'BFIS1', 'BIHT' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter, Boba Fett In Slave I, Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Twilek Adviso' dested Twi'lek Advisor; 'Bad feeling' dested Bad Feeling Have I; 'Monok/ketwol' dested Monnok; 'Walker Garnison' dested Walker Garrison; 'Jaba trou With You' dested Jabba's Through With You; 'Operation As Planed' dested Operational As Planned.
Come Here You Big Coward, Secret Plans and No Escape are 2001 Effects (not Reflections III Defensive Shields), counted in the 60.
